title: Tom and the Little Dog
text:
Tom is a little boy. He has a red ball and a blue bike. Every day, he rides his bike to the park. He likes to play with his ball there.

One day, Tom saw a small dog under a tree. The dog was wet and cold. Tom gave the dog some water and a piece of bread. Now the dog is his friend.

questions.text: What did Tom give the dog?
options: Some water and a piece of bread

questions.text: How did the dog probably feel before Tom helped it?
How does Tom feel about the dog at the end of the story?
options: He wants to be its friend
He does not care about it

vocabulary.definition: covered with water or containing water
a food made from flour and water, baked in an oven
a person you like and spend time with

paragraph_translations: Tom jest małym chłopcem. Ma czerwoną piłkę i niebieski rower. Codziennie jeździ rowerem do parku. Lubi tam bawić się swoją piłką.
Pewnego dnia Tom zobaczył małego psa pod drzewem. Pies był mokry i zimny. Tom dał psu trochę wody i kawałek chleba. Teraz pies jest jego przyjacielem.
